department: School of Chemical and Process Engineering

deadline.value: Applicants are advised to apply at least four months before their proposed start date; admissions operate on a rolling basis across multiple start dates.
deadline.quote: Deadlines We advise you to apply at least four months before your proposed start date. This is to allow sufficient time to review your application and undertake any additional checks.

also.quote: Our entry points are 1 September, 1 October, 1 February and 1 April, though some areas may offer only one or two start dates per year.

entry_route.value: Minimum entry requirements are a 2.1 honours degree or good performance in a Master's level course in a relevant subject.
entry_route.quote: The minimum entry requirements for PhD study is a 2.1 honours degree, or equivalent, in a subject relating to your proposed area of research, or a good performance in a Masters level course in a relevant subject.

supervisor.value: Applicants need to identify and contact available academic supervisors who are experts in their research topic prior to applying.
supervisor.quote: You need to identify the supervisors available to work with you. They must be experts in the topic you are interested in to ensure that your research is accurate and adding to current knowledge.

funding.value: Competition for research council scholarships and faculty awards is high and funding is competitive.
funding.quote: UK research councils: competition for these scholarships is high but the majority of your fees will be funded so it is well worth applying.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Chemical and Process Engineering PhD) in the School of Chemical and Process Engineering at the University of Leeds; covers materials science and engineering.
